title: Which siblings should pair first?
hook: Removing one root leaves several heaps to reunite.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Heap parent/child ordering and priority comparisons.
doesNotKnow: Delete a pairing-heap minimum using pairwise sibling melds then a right-to-left accumulation.

misconception: Removing the root only needs one arbitrary left-to-right sibling fold.
objective: Delete a pairing-heap minimum using pairwise sibling melds then a right-to-left accumulation.

claims.text: The first pass links adjacent sibling pairs; the second combines those winners from right to left. The trace retains attached children, showing why delete-min is more than merely choosing the smallest child.
